evidence.quote: The degree programme lasts seven semesters.
All courses are taught in English.

notes: No intake dates with day/month/year stated for this programme; the DAAD page says applications can be submitted each year from late April/early May onwards for the winter semester (1 October), but no exact deadline with a year is given for Applied Informatics. The HSWT application page states '28 April 2026 - 27 July 2026 Application period for the winter semester 2026/2027 Bachelor Applied Informatics' but this is a general context without explicitly saying it applies to non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants, and the programme is not listed among those with restricted admission/hochschulstart, so the applicant should verify the deadline directly. Tuition: none is charged for this programme; only a semester contribution of 97 EUR/semester applies, which is not a tuition fee.
